'''Justice''' was a series of agencies that were part of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]]. They were responsible for creating uniform legal code to be enforced in [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] across the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The implementation of the new legal system increased efficiency due to the efforts of Justice personnel. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]] attempted to write the idea of "Imperial Infallibility" into the legal code. The effort was resisted by Justice personnel, causing [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] personnel to harass members and intimidate the politically-connected by charging less-prominent members with fabricated charges. Progress began to assign new personnel to Justice who shared the Emperor's view on the way the law should work.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
